pages.text: The Sky Configurator stores a line name, line ID, and resource toggles. Right-click air to open the configurator screen; right-click a node to open its node screen. Holding the configurator in the offhand while placing a node makes the new node inherit its line and resource toggles.
The configurator is the starting point for creating lines and copying settings in bulk.

Sneak-right-click a node with the configurator to copy that node and enter paste mode. While in paste mode, right-click another node to write the stored line and resource toggles to it. Sneak-right-click again, open the configurator screen, or stop holding the configurator to leave paste mode.

pages.title: Speed Upgrade
pages.text: Speed Upgrades stack in one node upgrade slot. Each card adds one slot check per tick.$(br2)By default, up to 8 cards raise the base rate from 1 to 9 slots/t. The server can configure this limit.
Speed Upgrades can be crafted at a crafting table.

pages.title: Dimension Upgrade
pages.text: Dimension Upgrades only need to be installed on extract nodes. They allow resources to reach same-line insert nodes in other dimensions.$(br2)They do not load chunks. Unloaded dimensions or target chunks are skipped.
Tier 2 offering: place a Nether Star on the altar, then place 4 Eyes of Ender and 1 Chora Nectar on offering tables.$(br2)The ritual takes about 12 seconds.

pages.title: Force Extraction
pages.text: Install it only on extract nodes. For server-whitelisted devices, it bypasses the external interface's 64-item return limit.$(br2)It extracts the amount the target can actually accept. A rejected transfer restores the source slot.

The device whitelist defaults to mekanism_extras; an empty list disables this feature.$(br2)Tier 2 offering: put a Speed Upgrade on the altar, then offer 4 Blaze Rods, 4 Magma Creams, 4 Crying Obsidian, and 1 Netherite Scrap.

pages.title: Ordered Matching
pages.text: Install this upgrade on item extract or insert nodes. Right-click air to switch Per Slot/Per Item; Per Slot is the default.$(br2)Switching to Per Item clears the order offset. Switching back to Per Slot therefore starts at 0.
Ordered Matching Upgrades can be crafted at a crafting table.

pages.title: Per Slot: Mapping
pages.text: Per Slot follows:$(br)local slot + order offset$(br)= network position$(br2)Extract nodes map local slots to receivers. Insert nodes reverse the same relation to map sources to inventory slots.

pages.title: Per Slot: Offset
pages.text: Sneak-scroll up/down to raise/lower the offset without changing the hotbar.$(br2)Positive skips network positions: offset 2 maps slot 0 to position 2.$(br2)Negative skips local slots: offset -2 maps slot 2 to position 0.

pages.title: Per Item Mode
pages.text: Extract nodes cycle receivers; insert nodes cycle inventory slots. The cursor advances only after success.$(br2)Every target visited by a batch consumes its own budget. Order offsets do not apply in Per Item mode.

pages.title: Per Item Failures
pages.text: A failed extraction assignment stays in its source and enters the persistent detention queue for priority retries.$(br2)The default queue length is 1. A full queue prevents passing another newly failed target.

pages.title: Network Order Lists
pages.text: Items, fluids, FE, chemicals, mana, and source each have separate source and receiver lists.$(br2)Fullness and filter contents do not affect membership. Equal priorities remain separate, and the Configurator uses the same order.
